scope: Direct visual review of the 20 actual formal browser-a1 captures for the bounded native short-landscape globe controls and Booky placement fix.
method: Each of the 20 original PNG files was opened directly with view_image; metadata is taken from its formal source-evidence capture and checked against original bytes.

findings: Russian desktop helper, close control and main action labels are legible; character and magnifier render without clipping.
Floating helper overlays part of the archive; this capture does not establish universal access to underlying content.
Actual 256px drawing buffer shows the green book model, rounded eyes, articulated gloves and shoes; magnifier shaft visually meets the right glove.
English narrow guide fits horizontally; current Search focus and helper close are visible. Character and its controls remain below the card.
Guide is an internally scrollable card; lower content is outside this captured scroll position.
English short landscape guide, its close and highlighted Search target are visible; character and compact row remain inside the viewport.
Open guide overlays the middle of the edition rail and part of the globe dock. The strict new dock reachability claim applies with this optional guide closed.
Russian desktop margin-walk capture shows the live character and explicit Stop control; globe toolbar and archive close remain visible.
Character overlays some ordinary archive content; a still image does not itself prove motion.
Russian approach capture shows the selected graphics section, focus cue and finite-motion Stop control; collection locale and close remain clear.
Character overlaps explanatory content at the lower right; behavioral arrival and cancellation are established by the accompanying test.
Russian 320px controls, appearance button, edition arrows, globe dock and collapsed country archive are visible; compact character controls fit above the dock.
The walk control covers part of the zoom-status text; this is outside the tested navigation hit targets.
English 320px version preserves compact character controls, locale access, globe dock and archive header within the viewport.
The walk control covers part of the zoom-status text; no complete unobstructed-content claim is made.
English 800px landscape has clear top navigation, edition rail, globe dock and country header; compact Booky row fits between them.
English landscape collection header, locale switch, close and visible book detail buttons remain clear.
Floating Booky overlaps one book card title; ordinary content under the movable character is not fully unobstructed.
English 320px collection helper fits horizontally; its close and collection header controls are visible.
Character and open helper overlay part of the shelf content and control area. This retained overlay state is excluded from universal navigation or full accessibility acceptance.
Russian narrow useful-actions card shows readable action labels in its current scroll position; character remains below the card and globe dock stays visible.
Card content extends beyond the captured scroll position; the image alone does not certify every helper action.
English desktop gesture grid is legible; selected shy reaction and Surprise me focus are visible. Character, glove and magnifier remain coherent.
Russian 800x400 collapsed archive is compact; all five visible globe dock controls sit above its boundary. Booky row leaves dock, country action and top navigation visually clear.
English 800x400 preserves the same separation of globe dock, compact archive header and Booky row. Open archive action and Source control are clear.
English 667x375 dock fits fully across the width above the country header; zoom, pause, reset and source controls are visually clear. Compact Booky row stays above the dock.
English expanded 667x375 archive leaves the country header, Expand action and inner close button clear.
Booky row moves left of the inner close button; some archive heading/content is overlaid by the optional character.
Russian saved reader profile displays readable age, level, local-save confirmation and delete action; character stays beside the card.
English narrow reader-profile draft displays readable age and reading-level fields without horizontal clipping.
Save control is partially below the captured internal scroll position; this is not evidence that all form controls are simultaneously visible.
English failed-deletion state shows a clear error message and Try deleting again action; profile fields and character render normally.

scopedFindings: New collapsed short-landscape captures separate globe dock, country header and Booky controls at 800x400 and 667x375 in the exercised locales.
Expanded 667x375 capture confirms that both country header and the inner archive close button remain visually clear.
No visual blocker was found for this bounded source change.
limitations: This is browser screenshot review, not installed-device, nonzero operating-system safe-area, full accessibility, stage, release or model-art acceptance.

Open helper cards and the movable character can overlay some content and, in retained guide/collection states, underlying control areas. The new strict landscape reachability claim concerns the closed-guide states exercised by the new case.
Static captures do not prove animation, focus, hit testing, persistence or canonical scene identity; those claims rely on the accompanying tests.
The existing 3D model is unchanged; these captures are not newly generated model portraits.
